title: job.dependency_declared
description: A job declared that it depends on another, at the intake's confirmation. No flowpilot equivalent: there the order between tickets is a convention, here it is a fact of the log. Declaring the edge blocks nobody — enforcing the order is another ficha's decision.

depends_on_job_id.description: The job the subject of the event depends on. The subject (entity.id) is always the DEPENDENT one: the one that waits is the one that carries the fact on its own timeline.
